title: Complete Tour
text: Knowledge with humor. Guide relates well to his guests. Pay attention to meeting address. It’s a block away from Park Entrance.
author: Matthew_L

title: A total wow!
text:
My friend and I arrived 20 minutes late because we couldn’t catch a taxi and they were kind enough to allow us to join the next group. We were so relieved and grateful.

Our guide was absolutely entertaining and informative. He explained aspects of Gaudi‘s art that made the experience really come alive.
author: SusanR1907

title: Excellent tour
text: Absolutely excellent thank you. The earphones to the microphone and following the umbrella made it a wonderful experience.
author: EstellaA3841IB

title: Great Way to See Park Guell
text: Our guide was great! She was very informative and engaging. Easy location to find for the start and everything ran on time. Highly recommend, especially if tickets are sold out.
author: Nancy_B

title: Lovely experience around Park Güell with a friendly tour guide, Sara.
text:
My friend and I booked with the Touring Pandas for a Guided Tour around Park Güell, and skipped the (very) long line to get in. 
Sara was our guide, she was born in Barcelona so her knowledge of the city and the Park was amazing! 
We had an ear piece and radio each to hang around our necks to be able to hear Sara (great, especially if we were at the back of the group). There were quite a few steps to walk up (understandable as the Park is built on an incline), so bear this in mind when you book; I did not see any wheelchair access areas, but that may be because I was taking too many photos of
author: Amy G

title: Informative, entertaining experience.
text: Albert was a knowledgeable, enthusiastic and entertaining tour guide. Park Guell is a wonderful example of Gaudi's amazing architecture. Loved all the mosiacs and thoughtfulness in design. You definitely need an informed guide, like Albert, or you would miss out on so much.
author: Narelle_L
